# Final Implementation Plan — Daily Chitas in Living Path

The Awtsmoos renews each date, each verse, each road, each gate;
Awtsmoos.com will reveal the weekly Sidra without storing tomorrow's state.

## Exact source files to create

1. `geelooy/heichelos/heichel/modules/chitas/constants.js`
	- virtual series identity, Heichel Ikar scope, weekday labels, source labels.
2. `geelooy/heichelos/heichel/modules/chitas/date-policy.js`
	- local-date keys, Sunday week start, seven study dates, aliyah number, official Chabad date links.
3. `geelooy/heichelos/heichel/modules/chitas/hebcal-provider.js`
	- browser-safe Hebcal URL construction and calendar fetch with Diaspora/Israel switch.
4. `geelooy/heichelos/heichel/modules/chitas/schedule.js`
	- pure next-parsha selection, seven aliyah extraction, Simchat Torah recognition, study-card metadata.
5. `geelooy/heichelos/heichel/modules/chitas/virtual-series.js`
	- root special grouping and the virtual Daily Chitas series payload consumed by Living Path.

## Exact existing files to rewrite completely

6. `geelooy/heichelos/heichel/modules/navigator/loader.js`
	- route `daily-chitas` through the virtual source, inject the special grouping only into Heichel Ikar root, avoid DND for virtual content.
7. `geelooy/heichelos/heichel/modules/ui/render/living-path/cards.js`
	- allow only trusted Chabad daily-study external links for virtual study cards and suppress unrelated social/menu actions.
8. `geelooy/heichelos/heichel/modules/ui/controls.js`
	- clear and hide owner mutation controls while the current series is virtual.

## Exact tests to create

9. `tests/geelooy/chitasSchedule.test.mjs`
	- ordinary Sunday mapping, seven aliyah extraction, double-parsha compatibility, holiday-deferral selection, Simchat Torah marker, local week construction.
10. `tests/geelooy/chitasLivingPathContract.test.mjs`
	- static contract for Ikar-only grouping injection, virtual loader interception, trusted external navigation, and virtual owner-control suppression.

## Thirty final refinements before writing

1. Use browser-local civil dates, never UTC date slicing.
2. Construct dates at local noon to reduce DST boundary hazards.
3. Keep Sunday=aliyah 1 through Shabbos=aliyah 7 explicit.
4. Search forward far enough to survive multi-day festival displacement.
5. Select only Hebcal records whose category is exactly `parashat`.
6. Never substitute a holiday Torah reading for the Chitas Sidra.
7. Let a displaced Shabbos naturally repeat the next actual Sidra.
8. Accept combined parsha titles without splitting them apart.
9. Consume the combined parsha's seven full leyning aliyos.
10. Preserve Hebrew parsha name from Hebcal when available.
11. Keep the provider separate from pure scheduling logic.
12. Keep Chabad URL construction separate from Hebcal retrieval.
13. Link to Chabad's exact civil-date Daily Chumash page rather than copying translation text.
14. Mark each generated study card as virtual and non-social.
15. Restrict external card navigation to `https://www.chabad.org/dailystudy/`.
16. Keep ordinary posts, series, and groupings behavior unchanged.
17. Surface the Chitas grouping only at `heichelId=ikar`, `seriesId=root`.
18. Do not persist a date-changing alternate-group record.
19. Give the grouping a stable `daily-chitas` id for progress/history URLs.
20. Make the virtual series itself render through the ordinary posts viewport.
21. Include all seven days so the user can review ahead/behind within the weekly grouping.
22. Prefix today's card visibly without changing its canonical date identity.
23. Include exact aliyah reference in each card description when Hebcal supplies it.
24. Degrade to seven official Chabad date links if Hebcal is unavailable.
25. Treat Simchat Torah as an explicit exceptional day and defer exact text detail to Chabad's canonical page.
26. Allow an explicit `chitasIsrael=1` query switch instead of guessing geography.
27. Hide owner mutation controls for virtual series.
28. Disable DND initialization for virtual series.
29. Re-read every touched file and enforce the small-file/tab/B"H contract.
30. Run node tests, syntax checks, and a browser/runtime smoke path before claiming completion.

## Calculation contract

For an ordinary date `D`:

`candidate events = Hebcal(D ... D+35, parsha=on, major holidays=on, Israel mode explicit)`

`sidra = first event where category === "parashat"`

`aliyos = sidra.leyning["1"] ... sidra.leyning["7"]`

`todayAliyah = D.getDay() + 1`

This works during festival displacement because the displaced Shabbos has no `parashat` event, so the same next actual Sidra remains selected and its weekday passages repeat, matching Chabad's stated Chitas rule.

Simchat Torah is the explicit exception: the exact canonical Chabad date page is the authority for that day's Vezot Haberachah/Bereishit transition, while following days resume the upcoming Bereishit weekday aliyos.

## Completion evidence required

- all ten files exist with intended contracts;
- test fixtures demonstrate Nitzavim-Vayeilech and the 2026 Rosh Hashanah -> Ha'azinu deferral;
- ordinary Living Path remains internal-navigation based;
- virtual Chitas cards navigate only to trusted Chabad daily-study URLs;
- source files read back with tabs, no minification, no source file over 120 lines;
- browser Heichel Ikar root shows Daily Chitas grouping and opening it shows seven daily portions.
